map.验签只证明令牌未被篡改，业务还需自行校验声明：exp（是否过期）、nbf（是否未: Verification only proves the token was not tampered with; the business layer still has to validate the claims itself: exp (expired?), nbf (not yet valid?), iss/aud (do issuer and audience match?), plus any custom permission fields. Servers also usually check a token blacklist or a version number, none of which signature verification covers.

map.按点号切分令牌，段数不为 3 判为格式错误。解码采用 base64url：先把: Splits the token on dots; anything other than 3 segments is a format error. Decoding uses base64url: replace - with + and _ with /, pad with = to a multiple of 4, decode bytes with atob, convert each byte to %HH, then run decodeURIComponent to correctly restore UTF-8 Chinese. Verification: current seconds = ⌊Date.now() ÷ 1000⌋; if exp exists and the current time > exp it is marked expired, otherwise the remaining time is split into days = ⌊remaining ÷ 86400⌋ and hours = ⌊(remaining mod 86400) ÷ 3600⌋; if nbf exists and the current time < nbf it is marked not yet valid; time fields such as iat are also shown as local time by multiplying the value × 1000.
